//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Healing Campfire -> Config

Enable Healing Campfire.//: Whether Healing Campfire is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

checkForCampfireDelayInTicks.//: How often in ticks the mod checks for campfires around the player. 1 second = 20 ticks, so by default every 2 seconds. min: 1, max: 1,200

healingRadius.//: The radius around the campfire in blocks where players receive the campfire's effects. min: 1, max: 64

effectDurationSeconds.//: The duration of the effects which the campfire applies. min: 1, max: 600

regenerationLevel.//: The level of the effects which the campfire applies, by default 1. min: 1, max: 50

campfireEffects.//: The effects which the campfire applies, by default regeneration.

healPassiveMobs.//: When enabled, the campfire heals passive mobs around where the radius is half the width of a bounding box.

mobsThatAreNotHealed.//: Mobs that never receive the campfire's effects.

secondsAfterMobDamageBeforeHealing.//: How many seconds after being hurt by a mob or player the campfire waits before applying its effects again. 0 disables the wait. min: 0, max: 600

hideEffectParticles.//: When enabled, hides the particles from the effects around the campfire.

campfireMustBeLit.//: When enabled, the campfire only has an effect when the block is lit up.

campfireMustBeSignalling.//: When enabled, the campfire only has an effect when the block is signalling.

enableEffectForNormalCampfires.//: When enabled, the mod will work with normal campfires.

enableEffectForSoulCampfires.//: When enabled, the mod will work with soul campfires.

soulCampfireHealingRadius.//: The radius around a soul campfire in blocks where its effects are applied. min: 1, max: 64

soulCampfireEffectDurationSeconds.//: The duration of the effects which a soul campfire applies. min: 1, max: 600

soulCampfireEffectLevel.//: The level of the effects which a soul campfire applies, by default 1. min: 1, max: 50

soulCampfireEffects.//: The effects which a soul campfire applies, by default regeneration.

soulCampfiresHealHostileMobsInstead.//: When enabled, soul campfires apply their effects to hostile mobs instead of players and passive mobs.
